sentences.zh: 乾隆元年丙辰

translations.literal: Qianlong 1st year, year bingchen
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 1 (1736), year bingchen

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiawu, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the eleventh month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉遷。三月甲寅左副都御史。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiyou, transferred. Third month, day jiayin, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the second month he was transferred out; on the jiayin day of the third month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午遷。左副都御史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiawu, transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the eleventh month he was transferred to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年丁巳

translations.literal: Qianlong 2nd year, year dingsi
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 2 (1737), year dingsi

sentences.zh: 七月癸丑遷。八月辛巳左副都御史。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day guichou, transferred. Eighth month, day xinsi, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the seventh month he was transferred out; on the xinsi day of the eighth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三年戊午

translations.literal: Qianlong 3rd year, year wuwu
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 3 (1738), year wuwu

sentences.zh: 四月甲申免。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jiashen, dismissed. Lifan Yuan Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the fourth month he was dismissed from office as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 四月辛丑理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day xinchou, Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the fourth month he was appointed Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 四月辛丑遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day xinchou, transferred. Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the fourth month he was transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 遷。正月乙卯左都御史。七月丁卯遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Transferred. First month, day yimao, Left Censor-in-Chief. Seventh month, day dingmao, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred out; on the yimao day of the first month he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief; on the dingmao day of the seventh month he was transferred again while holding that post.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午乞休。七月壬子左都御史。十二月丙戌革。左都御史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingwu, requested retirement. Seventh month, day renzi, Left Censor-in-Chief. Twelfth month, day bingxu, dismissed. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the sixth month he requested retirement; on the renzi day of the seventh month he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief; on the bingxu day of the twelfth month he was dismissed from that post.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑左副都御史。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guichou, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the ninth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四年己未

translations.literal: Qianlong 4th year, year jiwei
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 4 (1739), year jiwei

sentences.zh: 遷。四月乙未左都御史。

translations.literal: Transferred. Fourth month, day yiwei, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred out; on the yiwei day of the fourth month he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 七月乙卯遷。左副都御史。丙寅遷。左副都御史。十二月己卯遷。庚寅左副都御史。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day yimao, transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Day bingyin, transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Twelfth month, day jimao, transferred. Day gengyin, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the seventh month he was transferred out while serving as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on day bingyin he was transferred again in that post; on the jimao day of the twelfth month he was transferred out, and on day gengyin he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午降。左副都御史。五月辛亥遷。左副都御史。十一月庚寅左副都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengwu, demoted. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Fifth month, day xinhai, transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Eleventh month, day gengyin, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the third month he was demoted to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on the xinhai day of the fifth month he was transferred out while holding that post; on the gengyin day of the eleventh month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五年庚申

translations.literal: Qianlong 5th year, year gengshen
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 5 (1740), year gengshen

sentences.zh: 革。三月己巳左都御史。

translations.literal: Dismissed. Third month, day jisi, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was dismissed from office; on the jisi day of the third month he had been serving as Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 就餓癸丑遷。甲午左都御史。己卯遷。壬午左都御史。

translations.literal: Jiu'e, day guichou, transferred. Day jiawu, Left Censor-in-Chief. Day jimao, transferred. Day renwu, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On day guichou he was transferred out; on day jiawu he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief; on day jimao he was transferred again; on day renwu he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 閏六月甲子左副都御史。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, day jiazi, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the intercalary sixth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未降。三月己未左副都御史。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiwei, demoted. Third month, day jiwei, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the second month he was demoted; on the jiwei day of the third month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午遷。十二月辛丑左副都御史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renwu, transferred. Twelfth month, day xinchou, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the eleventh month he was transferred out; on the xinchou day of the twelfth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 六月告養免。七月己丑左副都御史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, dismissed to care for parents. Seventh month, day jichou, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he was dismissed to care for his parents; on the jichou day of the seventh month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆六年辛酉

translations.literal: Qianlong 6th year, year xinyou
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 6 (1741), year xinyou

sentences.zh: 九月遷。丁亥左都御史。

translations.literal: Ninth month, transferred. Day dinghai, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he was transferred out; on day dinghai he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 七月甲申乞休免。八月己亥左副都御史。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day jiashen, requested retirement and was dismissed. Eighth month, day jihai, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the seventh month he requested retirement and was relieved of office; on the jihai day of the eighth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆七年壬戌

translations.literal: Qianlong 7th year, year renxu
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 7 (1742), year renxu

sentences.zh: 十二月革逮。丙午左副都御史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, dismissed and arrested. Day bingwu, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was dismissed and arrested; on day bingwu he had been serving as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆八年癸亥

translations.literal: Qianlong 8th year, year guihai
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 8 (1743), year guihai

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯遷。理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingmao, transferred. Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the sixth month he was transferred to Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Sixth month, transferred. Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he was transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰病免。左副都御史。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiachen, dismissed on account of illness. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the second month he was dismissed because of illness while serving as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰左副都御史。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiachen, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the second month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆九年甲子

translations.literal: Qianlong 9th year, year jiazi
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 9 (1744), year jiazi

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳左副都御史。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinsi, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the ninth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 正月庚子遷。二月己未左副都御史。十二月戊辰遷。左副都御史。

translations.literal: First month, day gengzi, transferred. Second month, day jiwei, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Twelfth month, day wuchen, transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the first month he was transferred out; on the jiwei day of the second month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on the wuchen day of the twelfth month he was transferred again while holding that post.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十年乙丑

translations.literal: Qianlong 10th year, year yichou
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 10 (1745), year yichou

sentences.zh: 五月己亥遷。六月丁巳左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jihai, transferred. Sixth month, day dingsi, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the fifth month he was transferred out; on the dingsi day of the sixth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十一年丙寅

translations.literal: Qianlong 11th year, year bingyin
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 11 (1746), year bingyin

sentences.zh: 閏三月癸丑休致。左都御史。五月丙申遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, day guichou, retired. Left Censor-in-Chief. Fifth month, day bingshen, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the intercalary third month he retired as Left Censor-in-Chief; on the bingshen day of the fifth month he was transferred out while holding that post.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十二年丁卯

translations.literal: Qianlong 12th year, year dingmao
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 12 (1747), year dingmao

sentences.zh: 三月遷。五月庚寅左副都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, transferred. Fifth month, day gengyin, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he was transferred out; on the gengyin day of the fifth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 四月己巳乞休。左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jisi, requested retirement. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the fourth month he requested retirement while serving as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年戊辰

translations.literal: Qianlong 13th year, year wuchen
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 13 (1748), year wuchen

sentences.zh: 七月戊戌遷。閏七月癸丑左都御史。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day wuxu, transferred. Intercalary seventh month, day guichou, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the seventh month he was transferred out; on the guichou day of the intercalary seventh month he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 四月革。六月戊寅左副都御史。尋遷。七月辛丑左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fourth month, dismissed. Sixth month, day wuyin, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Soon transferred. Seventh month, day xinchou, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he was dismissed; on the wuyin day of the sixth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; soon afterward he was transferred out, and on the xinchou day of the seventh month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief again.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰遷。三月乙未左副都御史。六月卒。閏七月戊辰左副都御史。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingchen, transferred. Third month, day yiwei, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Sixth month, died. Intercalary seventh month, day wuchen, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the second month he was transferred out; on the yiwei day of the third month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; in the sixth month he died in office; on the wuchen day of the intercalary seventh month the post was filled again.

sentences.zh: 四月乙丑遷。庚午左副都御史。六月丙辰遷。庚申左副督御史。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day yichou, transferred. Day gengwu, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Sixth month, day bingchen, transferred. Day gengshen, Left Vice Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the fourth month he was transferred out; on day gengwu he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on the bingchen day of the sixth month he was transferred again; on day gengshen he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 閏七月庚申遷。左副都御史。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, day gengshen, transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the intercalary seventh month he was transferred out while serving as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十四年己巳

translations.literal: Qianlong 14th year, year jisi
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 14 (1749), year jisi

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengchen, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the twelfth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 正月丁巳休。左副都御史。

translations.literal: First month, day dingsi, retired. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the first month he retired while serving as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十五年庚午

translations.literal: Qianlong 15th year, year gengwu
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 15 (1750), year gengwu

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯遷。九月辛亥左都御史。十一月乙亥遇害。丙辰左都御史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinmao, transferred. Ninth month, day xinhai, Left Censor-in-Chief. Eleventh month, day yihai, met violent death. Day bingchen, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the eighth month he was transferred out; on the xinhai day of the ninth month he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief; on the yihai day of the eleventh month he met a violent death in office; on day bingchen the post was filled again.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯革。九月庚子左都御史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinmao, dismissed. Ninth month, day gengzi, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the eighth month he was dismissed; on the gengzi day of the ninth month he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 四月乙酉革。左副都御史。八月革。九月甲辰左副都御史。尋遷。左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day yiyou, dismissed. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Eighth month, dismissed. Ninth month, day jiachen, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Soon transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the fourth month he was dismissed from the post of Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; in the eighth month he was dismissed again; on the jiachen day of the ninth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; soon afterward he was transferred out while holding that post.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯革。九月甲子左副都御史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinmao, dismissed. Ninth month, day jiazi, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the eighth month he was dismissed; on the jiazi day of the ninth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十六年辛未

translations.literal: Qianlong 16th year, year xinwei
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 16 (1751), year xinwei

sentences.zh: 乾隆十七年壬申

translations.literal: Qianlong 17th year, year renshen
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 17 (1752), year renshen

sentences.zh: 七月卒。左副都御史。

translations.literal: Seventh month, died. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he died in office as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅遷。甲申左副都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuyin, transferred. Day jiashen, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the third month he was transferred out; on day jiashen he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十八年癸酉

translations.literal: Qianlong 18th year, year guiyou
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 18 (1753), year guiyou

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌免。十月辛丑左都御史。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiaxu, dismissed. Tenth month, day xinchou, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the ninth month he was dismissed from office; on the xinchou day of the tenth month he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 四月卒。己亥左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fourth month, died. Day jihai, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he died in office; on day jihai he had been serving as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 四月甲子遷。理藩院尚書。七月壬申降。理藩院尚書。十月甲辰遷。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jiazi, transferred. Lifan Yuan Minister. Seventh month, day renshen, demoted. Lifan Yuan Minister. Tenth month, day jiachen, transferred. Lifan Yuan Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the fourth month he was transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs; on the renshen day of the seventh month he was demoted but retained that post; on the jiachen day of the tenth month he was transferred out while holding it.

sentences.zh: 五月病免。壬申理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dismissed on account of illness. Day renshen, Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he was dismissed because of illness; on day renshen he had been serving as Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 正月己丑遷。兼署左都御史。四月甲子補。

translations.literal: First month, day jichou, transferred. Also acting as Left Censor-in-Chief. Fourth month, day jiazi, confirmed appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the first month he was transferred out while also serving as acting Left Censor-in-Chief; on the jiazi day of the fourth month his appointment was confirmed.

sentences.zh: 十月戊申乞休。辛亥左都御史。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day wushen, requested retirement. Day xinhai, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the tenth month he requested retirement; on day xinhai he had been serving as Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 五月遷。庚辰左都副御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, transferred. Day gengchen, Left Vice Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he was transferred out; on day gengchen he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未左副都御史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingwei, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the sixth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十二年丁酉

translations.literal: Qianlong 42nd year, year dingyou
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 42 (1777), year dingyou

sentences.zh: 三月戊子遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuzi, transferred. Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the third month he was transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未乞休。戊寅左都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinwei, requested retirement. Day wuyin, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the third month he requested retirement; on day wuyin he had been serving as Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十三年戊戌

translations.literal: Qianlong 43rd year, year wuxu
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 43 (1778), year wuxu

sentences.zh: 七月丁巳革。八月癸酉理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day dingsi, dismissed. Eighth month, day guiyou, Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the seventh month he was dismissed from office; on the guiyou day of the eighth month he was appointed Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月卒。甲寅左副都御史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, died. Day jiayin, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he died in office; on day jiayin he had been serving as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十四年己亥

translations.literal: Qianlong 44th year, year jihai
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 44 (1779), year jihai

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰遷。理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingchen, transferred. Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the twelfth month he was transferred to Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥病免。丙子左都御史。

translations.literal: Second month, day guihai, dismissed on account of illness. Day bingzi, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the second month he was dismissed because of illness; on day bingzi he had been serving as Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰遷。左副都御史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuchen, transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the twelfth month he was transferred out while serving as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十二月遷。戊辰左副都御史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, transferred. Day wuchen, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was transferred out; on day wuchen he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十五年庚子

translations.literal: Qianlong 45th year, year gengzi
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 45 (1780), year gengzi

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌遷。理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingxu, transferred. Lifan Yuan Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the third month he was transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 遷。二月辛酉理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Transferred. Second month, day xinyou, Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred out; on the xinyou day of the second month he was appointed Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰乞休。癸巳左都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, day renchen, requested retirement. Day guisi, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the third month he requested retirement; on day guisi he had been serving as Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰休致。五月左副都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, day renchen, retired. Fifth month, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the third month he retired; in the fifth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 四月辛酉遷。丁卯左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day xinyou, transferred. Day dingmao, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the fourth month he was transferred out; on day dingmao he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 三月遷。四月辛酉左副都御史。七月癸卯遷。八月左副都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, transferred. Fourth month, day xinyou, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Seventh month, day guimao, transferred. Eighth month, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he was transferred out; on the xinyou day of the fourth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; on the guimao day of the seventh month he was transferred again; in the eighth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief once more.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十六年辛丑

translations.literal: Qianlong 46th year, year xinchou
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 46 (1781), year xinchou

sentences.zh: 十一月丁巳遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingsi, transferred. Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the eleventh month he was transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁巳卒。左都御史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingsi, died. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the eleventh month he died in office as Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚子遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengzi, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the eleventh month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十七年壬寅

translations.literal: Qianlong 47th year, year renyin
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 47 (1782), year renyin

sentences.zh: 四月甲午遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jiawu, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the fourth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 二月遷。戊辰左副都御史。

translations.literal: Second month, transferred. Day wuchen, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he was transferred out; on day wuchen he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十八年癸卯

translations.literal: Qianlong 48th year, year guimao
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 48 (1783), year guimao

sentences.zh: 五月甲辰憂免。左都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiachen, dismissed due to mourning. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the fifth month he was dismissed to observe mourning while serving as Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十九年甲辰

translations.literal: Qianlong 49th year, year jiachen
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 49 (1784), year jiachen

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinsi, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the fifth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 卒。三月丁亥左都御史。

translations.literal: Died. Third month, day dinghai, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office; on the dinghai day of the third month he had been serving as Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十年乙巳

translations.literal: Qianlong 50th year, year yisi
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 50 (1785), year yisi

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉卒。丙戌理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yiyou, died. Day bingxu, Lifan Yuan Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the sixth month he died in office; on day bingxu he had been serving as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌遷。理藩院右侍郎。是月卒。丙午理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingxu, transferred. Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister. That month, died. Day bingwu, Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the sixth month he was transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and died in that same month; on day bingwu the post of Left Vice Minister was filled.

sentences.zh: 正月丁巳乞休。左都御史。

translations.literal: First month, day dingsi, requested retirement. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the first month he requested retirement while serving as Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 六月遷。左副都御史。尋遷。十一月庚申左副都御史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Soon transferred. Eleventh month, day gengshen, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he was transferred out while serving as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; soon afterward he was transferred again; on the gengshen day of the eleventh month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十一年丙午

translations.literal: Qianlong 51st year, year bingwu
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 51 (1786), year bingwu

sentences.zh: 四月丙申遷。五月左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day bingshen, transferred. Fifth month, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the fourth month he was transferred out; in the fifth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十二年丁未

translations.literal: Qianlong 52nd year, year dingwei
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 52 (1787), year dingwei

sentences.zh: 正月丁亥遷。二月甲辰左都御史。

translations.literal: First month, day dinghai, transferred. Second month, day jiachen, Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the first month he was transferred out; on the jiachen day of the second month he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 正月庚寅遷。二月庚申左副都御史。

translations.literal: First month, day gengyin, transferred. Second month, day gengshen, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the first month he was transferred out; on the gengshen day of the second month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十三年戊申

translations.literal: Qianlong 53rd year, year wushen
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 53 (1788), year wushen

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十四年己酉

translations.literal: Qianlong 54th year, year jiyou
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 54 (1789), year jiyou

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯休致。理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinmao, retired. Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the second month he retired while serving as Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Second month, transferred. Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he was transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥卒。左都御史。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinhai, died. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the ninth month he died in office as Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十五年庚戌

translations.literal: Qianlong 55th year, year gengxu
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 55 (1790), year gengxu

sentences.zh: 七月免。八月辛亥理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Seventh month, dismissed. Eighth month, day xinhai, Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he was dismissed from office; on the xinhai day of the eighth month he was appointed Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十六年戊申

translations.literal: Qianlong 56th year, year wushen
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 56 (1791), year wushen

sentences.zh: 八月自盡。九月乙亥理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Eighth month, committed suicide. Ninth month, day yihai, Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he committed suicide; on the yihai day of the ninth month the post of Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs was filled.

sentences.zh: 正月戊戌卒。左都御史。甲辰遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: First month, day wuxu, died. Left Censor-in-Chief. Day jiachen, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the first month he died in office as Left Censor-in-Chief; on day jiachen another officer was transferred to that post.

sentences.zh: 十月癸丑遷。十一月庚辰左副都御史。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day guichou, transferred. Eleventh month, day gengchen, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the tenth month he was transferred out; on the gengchen day of the eleventh month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十七年己酉

translations.literal: Qianlong 57th year, year jiyou
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 57 (1792), year jiyou

sentences.zh: 正月己亥遷。理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: First month, day jihai, transferred. Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the first month he was transferred to Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 正月己亥遷。理藩院右侍郎。九月庚子遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: First month, day jihai, transferred. Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister. Ninth month, day gengzi, transferred. Lifan Yuan Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the first month he was transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs; on the gengzi day of the ninth month he was transferred out while holding that post.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guiyou, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the eighth month he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月卒。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he died in office.

sentences.zh: 卒。四月辛酉左副都御史。

translations.literal: Died. Fourth month, day xinyou, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office; on the xinyou day of the fourth month he had been serving as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十八年癸丑

translations.literal: Qianlong 58th year, year guichou
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 58 (1793), year guichou

sentences.zh: 二月壬申左副都御史。十二月革。

translations.literal: Second month, day renshen, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Twelfth month, dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the second month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; in the twelfth month he was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十九年甲寅

translations.literal: Qianlong 59th year, year jiayin
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 59 (1794), year jiayin

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥左副都御史。

translations.literal: Second month, day guihai, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the second month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 八月卒。十月丙辰左副都御史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, died. Tenth month, day bingchen, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he died in office; on the bingchen day of the tenth month the post of Left Vice Censor-in-Chief was filled.

sentences.zh: 乾隆六十年乙卯

translations.literal: Qianlong 60th year, year yimao
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 60 (1795), year yimao

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingyin, Lifan Yuan Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the ninth month he was appointed Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 四月癸巳免。左都御史。八月丙申遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day guisi, dismissed. Left Censor-in-Chief. Eighth month, day bingshen, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the fourth month he was dismissed from the post of Left Censor-in-Chief; on the bingshen day of the eighth month he was transferred out while holding that post.

sentences.zh: 九月遷。十月己卯左副都御史。

translations.literal: Ninth month, transferred. Tenth month, day jimao, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he was transferred out; on the jimao day of the tenth month he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
